test_description: Histogram dimensionality & pointer safety — verify C array decay loses length (15-bin vs 17-bin cannot be checked at runtime) and probe NULL hist pointer handling
input_contract: const uint32_t hist[16] non-null 16-bin count array
independent_oracle: fork()-isolated NULL pointer probe + C++ signature inspection

expected.null_and_dim_guard: Explicit error/rejection on nullptr or wrong bin count without crash

actual.null_and_dim_guard: C array parameter decays to `const uint32_t*` (no length check); nullptr crashes with signal 11

assertion_notes: DEFECT: compute_nll_from_histogram(nullptr) and fit_histogram(model, nullptr) dereference NULL without guard (child signaled=11) and C array decay `const uint32_t hist[16]` carries no length metadata to reject 15-bin buffers.
